definitions.explanation: The act of publishing or printing content in newspapers, magazines, websites, or other media.

examples.japanese: {記事|きじ}が{新聞|しんぶん}に{掲載|けいさい}された。
examples.english: The article was published in the newspaper.

examples.japanese: ウェブサイトに{写真|しゃしん}を{掲載|けいさい}する{許可|きょか}をもらった。
examples.english: I got permission to post photos on the website.

examples.japanese: {広告|こうこく}の{掲載|けいさい}{料金|りょうきん}は{媒体|ばいたい}によって{異|こと}なる。
examples.english: Advertising rates vary depending on the publication medium.

notes:
{掲載|けいさい} is commonly used in publishing and media contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記事|きじ}を{掲載|けいさい}する: to publish an article
- {写真|しゃしん}を{掲載|けいさい}する: to post/publish a photo
- {広告|こうこく}を{掲載|けいさい}する: to run an advertisement
- {掲載|けいさい}{許可|きょか}: permission to publish
- {掲載|けいさい}{料|りょう}: publication fee

USAGE NOTE:
{掲載|けいさい}する is used as a suru-verb and commonly takes を for the object being published.
